name: pi-background-shell
description: Pi extension for background shell processes, bounded logs, task UI, completion notifications, and same-process reload handoff.
author: Ismail <ismailsalikhodjaev@gmail.com>

scripts.test:sdk: npm run build:runtime && node scripts/test-isolated.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/sdk/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test:package: npm run build:runtime && node scripts/test-isolated.mjs --test tests/package/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:type-safety && npm run test:unit && npm run test:sdk && npm run test:rpc && npm run test:component && npm run test:package
scripts.test:full: npm run test && npm run test:pty && npm run test:agent-loop
scripts.smoke: npm run build:runtime && node scripts/test-isolated.mjs scripts/smoke.ts
scripts.pack:dry-run: npm run build:runtime && npm run docs:verify && node scripts/check-package-payload.mjs
scripts.prepack: npm run build:runtime && npm run docs:verify && node scripts/check-package-payload.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test:type-safety && npm run docs:verify
scripts.verify: npm run docs:verify && npm run test:full && npm run smoke && npm run payload:check
